messages:
ana: heads-up — preflight for release window at 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. Planning to deploy runtime v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 (improves batching). Need API, router, console coordinated. Will do 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Any blockers?
mike: router needs pin to v2.4 routing rules. I can push pin at canary start. Will cloud-run sticky sessions be impacted?
ravi: console has schema change in /v1/serving-config. Need a migration step — UI will break if we flip before migration. I'll push migration script in PR #482.
sam: rollback criteria? What metrics should trigger automatic rollback? latency p50>200ms or error rate >1%?
julia: add token consumption spike >x3 for 5m as a quality regression trigger. Also add eval set check for hallucination rate.
deploy-bot: Deploy Check: preflight OK: infra green, CI passed, canary config available. Initiator: @ana. Use `/deploy release runtime v2.4 --canary 5,25,100 --wait 600` to start.
ana: I'll start release and tag release-notes. @ravi can you confirm migration PR will land before canary 1? Need it merged and db-migration job queued.
ravi: PR #482 merged to main, migration job queued: `kubectl apply -f migration-job.yaml` — ETA 8m. Will post logs.
ops-bot: Migration job: job/migrate-serving-config started (job-id: mj-20260325-01). Logs: https://logs.company.internal/mj-20260325-01
mike: router pin PR ready: route pin to `runtime:v2.4.0` with fallback `runtime:v2.3.1`. Will not flip weights until canary.
sam: I set rollback thresholds in rollout config: latency_p50=200ms, error_rate=1%, token_spike_factor=3x. Also set canary auto-stop on infra alerts.
ana: launching canary in 2m. Will monitor the console deploy tab and Alpine dashboards. Tag me for any manual rollback. :eyes: 
deploy-bot: Command received: `/deploy release runtime v2.4 --canary 5,25,100 --wait 600` — Can start in 30s. Track: https://deploys.company/runtime/v2.4
julia: test note: run eval set `regression/serve-smoke` after canary 5% and post score.
ana: all set. holding open 45m post-100% for secondary metrics. If anything unexpected, switch router pin back to v2.3.1 and trigger rollback job.
mike: ack. I'll be on standby for pin flips.
ravi: migration job finished: 0 errors. Logs: https://logs.company.internal/mj-20260325-01/finished. Starting UI smoke in 30s.
julia: smoke eval passed. hallucination delta <0.5%. Good to proceed to 25%.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 (5%) complete. Metrics: latency p50 +5ms, error_rate 0.1%. Proceeding to 25% as configured.
ana: moving to 25% now. Thanks all. :tada:
